reviewer: Claude agent, automated. One agent wrote the generator and ran the checks; a second automated pass reviewed the draft and the batch was rebuilt to fix its findings. No human review
scope: 92 records for Rewire's evo2-cloud-operations study at commit f8ae11c9a1c45505487c978b4cb7e064c4e59905. extract/build_batch.py reads each value as the literal JSON number token at a recorded pointer, re-reads every pointer from the same bytes after building, and asserts record counts, the attempt used per platform that each receipt reports a completed run of 3,893 variants, that every record is source_checked with no run recipe, and that a result cites a receipt only when its value is read from it. All eleven source files were downloaded again from their raw URLs and hash to the recorded SHA-256. Details are in docs/reviews/2026-11-21-evo2-cloud-operations-records.md.
limitations: No record is marked reproduced. The run receipts hold no AUROC and no hash of the scores file, and the Runpod L40S throughput of the recorded run (0.6117) was not repeated by the study's reproduction run (0.9081 on another host).
Nothing was rerun. No GPU or paid run was made.
The runs are the project's own, not an independent reproduction.
npm run batch -- check-values was not run: it parses table and row locators, not JSON pointers. The generator's own re-read replaces it.
The results of reproduction run 30e7ae49 are not ingested; only its Runpod L40S receipt is cited, for the throughput limitation.
